text:
Ravi: Quick pop-in  soft-opening two small Dedicated EdgeXL pools in Porto (OPO) and Accra (ACC) today. Target: sub-20ms P50 for small-chat and embeddings at the edge. Docs + short reservation guidance below. :rocket:
deploy-bot: [deploy] created pool edgexl-porto (size=10) and pool edgexl-accra (size=6)  rollout=rl-2026-edgexl-01
Zara: Nice! Is this pilot or GA?
Ravi: Pilot-limited; invite-first reserved slots (strategic customers) + open short-burst holds. Reservation window = max 72h for now. If telemetry looks good, we'll add to reserved catalog Q4.
sales: Heads-up: please flag as "pilot-limited-capacity" in quotes and mention edge-optimized latency benefits vs standard L-class. Include caveat about model size limits.
billing: Pricing: edge premium = +9% per GPU-hour vs standard Dedicated. Provide code EDGEXL-PILOT for quotes; enterprise customers can request an exception via billing case.
Zara: Eviction/preempt policy? Any special routing?
Ravi: Soft-reclaim applies: 25m eviction notice via webhook; we attempt an in-place KV sync to minimize cold-starts. Auto-fallback routing to nearest L-class pool if reclaim occurs. Also added a transient-prefetch option for customers to warm KV for first request.
infra-team: Tagging policy: require tags: region, project, team, edge=true (e.g., `region=opo project=voice edge=true`). Untagged holds auto-cancel after 8h. Nightly cleanup clears stale holds.
eng-oncall: Monitoring rule created: metric pool.edgexl-*-utilization >= 80% for 10m -> page #eng-oncall and notify #infra if error_rate > 3%. Also track P50/P95 separately due to edge focus.
Ravi: CLI snippet for engineers/customers:
```
# list edge xl pools in Porto
redwoodctl pools list --filter "edgexl" --region opo
# reserve 1 GPU for 24h
redwoodctl reservations create --pool edgexl-porto --count 1 --duration 24h --tags project=my-app,edge=true
# activate transient prefetch
redwoodctl reservations update --id <reservation-id> --meta prefetch=true
```
sales: Reminder to include model compatibility note: EdgeXL supports models up to 7B with quantized kernels; large 70B models not supported. Link to compatibility matrix in doc.
billing: We'll append billing code EDGEXL-PILOT and set trial credits for invited customers. Please annotate reservations with sales case ID for reconciliation.
Ravi: Customer doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/edgexl-pilot (reservation flow, eviction webhook payload, prefetch guide, pricing, SLA caveat). Dashboard link will be added by EOD.
Zara: Any SLA differences?
Ravi: Uptime SLA unchanged for Dedicated; customer docs will note "pilot-limited-capacity" and expected availability caveats.
eng-oncall: If edge P50 increases > 30% for 3 intervals, auto-fallback to L-class triggers and infra will be paged.
Ravi: Thanks all  please escalate urgent issues to #eng-oncall and tag reservations correctly. :pray:
